dataset: Mankoff et al. (2020) Greenland ice basins, k = 1.0

source.name: Mankoff et al. (2020) Streams, Outlets, Basins, and Discharge [k=1.0]

note: Divides between the basins that drain to one outlet each at the margin of the ice sheet or of a glacier around it, routed under ice-overburden water pressure on a 100 m grid. Only divides between two basins of at least min_area_km2 are kept; the ice margin is not.
